blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A court has convicted a former AirAsia senior cabin crew member of discriminating against three deaf passengers who were offloaded from a flight in 2017. The Municipal Trial Court in Cities (MTCC), Branch 1, in Puerto Princesa found Richie A. Rojas liable under Republic Act No. 7277, or the Magna Carta for Disabled Persons, as amended by RA 9442, in a decision issued on Oct. 29. Rojas was fined P50,000. The case stemmed from a May 2017 incident in which Rojas offloaded Khalil F. Haj and two other deaf Filipino passengers, the Iloilo Metropolitan Times reported. The court […]...
